flavor: A circular chamber of polished white stone where the air hums with a constant, low-frequency vibration. In the center, a slender spire of translucent quartz rises toward a vent in the ceiling, catching a perpetual updraft that makes the very dust dance in rhythmic, swirling patterns.
name: The Hollow of Resonant Sighs
reason: The shrine commemorates the Great Breath, a deity of wind and transition, and serves as a waypoint for travelers seeking clarity through meditation.
